*   WithCustomFuncs must be an exported function in the testutils package that accepts variadic interface{} fuzzer functions and returns a FuzzOption that registers those custom fuzzer functions.

36		results := make(map[string]bool, len(expected))

39		}

41		f := fuzz.NewWithSeed(seed) // helps with troubleshooting
42

44			if t.Failed() { // else a bit noisy
45				t.Logf("expected to see:  %#v", expected)
46				t.Logf("observed results: %#v", results)
47				t.Logf("detailed results: %#v", details)

51

53			for i := 0; i < 100; i++ { // always fuzz a moderate amount, don't stop immediately

55				details = append(details, res)
